verdict.rationale: skills.sh keeps no account-bound data. The CLI runs keylessly with no account (probe-rt-1), and skills are plain SKILL.md files with YAML frontmatter and Markdown, stored in local project or global directories that can be committed to your repo. Those files are reusable across any skills-compatible agent, and a skills-lock.json manifest restores installs, so leaving amounts to keeping your files. Missing for 10: an explicit export or data-portability statement, documentation of what server-side data (e.g. install telemetry behind the leaderboard) skills.sh retains and whether it can be exported or deleted, and independent corroboration of migrating away.
